messages:
anna: Quick update — we're scheduling a dedicated capacity wave in EU-NORTH for a new GPU class: mi400 (32GB, fp16/quant-friendly). Target start: Tue Apr 7 00:00 UTC.
anna: Plan is zone-staggered (eu-north-1a -> 1b -> 1c), ~24 nodes added per zone over ~48h windows. pools will be labeled `mi400-eu-north` and `mi400-eu-north-burst`.
anna: TL;DR for customers: short maintenance windows (no tenant VM downtime), soft quota bump for existing Dedicated customers on request. New reservations accepted after rollout completes in a zone.
cheng: How are we handling routing fallbacks for customers pinned to older skus?
gauraV (ops): we built a compatibility route — requests pinned to older families will auto-failover to l4p-compatible variants if mi400 is not in their plan. For dedicated reservations pinned to mi400 explicitly, no automatic fallback.
sara: Billing note — mi400 will bill at the new "mi400-dedicated" SKU rate. For existing reserved pools, we'll prorate if customers migrate during the rollout. I'll post the price sheet eta in #finance shortly.
anna: docs draft up at https://intranet.redwood/products/dedicated/mi400-rollout (internal). Migration guide excerpt: 
```
rwctl pools create --region eu-north --gpu mi400 --count 24 --pool-name mi400-eu-north
rwctl reservations allocate --pool mi400-eu-north --customer acme-inc --nodes 12
```
cheng: Ops question — what telemetry should SRE watch? Latency P50/P95 token-level, kv-cache hit-rate, and early OOM signals from the driver. We'll enable a short-lived debug sampler.
ops-bot: SCHEDULED: mi400 capacity wave starting 2035763200 (Tue Apr 7 00:00 UTC). Maintenance windows: 2035763200-2035849599 per zone.
matt: Is there an opt-in test window for partners prior to full zone rollout?
anna: Yes — we have a partner preview for a few strategic customers next Mon (Apr 6) 18:00-22:00 UTC in eu-north-1a. Tickets already flagged.
sara: Support playbook: use tag `mi400-rollout` on infra tickets; escalation path includes @cheng and @gaurav. We'll provide a canned response for customers asking about performance delta and migration steps.
support-bot: TEMPLATE: "We’re deploying mi400 to EU-NORTH. If you need earlier access, reply with your project id and required nodes. Billing/proration details will be shared after confirmation"
cheng: one more — quantization profiles will be opt-in during preview; full automatic profiles go live after a 2-week bake.
anna: Notes for eng teams: please avoid long-running training jobs on these dedicated nodes during the rollout window; it's inference-only capacity.
gauraV: capacity targets per zone: +24 (1a), +24 (1b), +16 (1c) initially, +8 overflow for burst. We'll update the pool counts in the console as each wave completes.
matt: :thumbsup: thanks team, looks good.
anna: I'll post a short follow-up summary after the partner preview. Ping me for any questions or if you need customer lists for early access.
